title: Casa Viva
subtitle: Art Deco villa of brick and stone
description:
Casa Viva carries the spirit of Art Deco and a taste for honest materials. Behind its ochre walls, facing the golf course, a brick vault stretches above the living room, carried by great red arches. Light passes through a glass wall two stories high, slides across a polished stone floor veined with gold and brown, and gives the house the warmth of a lived in gallery.

From one room to the next, the materials answer each other freely. A floating staircase with curved steel rails rises beneath exposed metal ducts, alongside a wooden bookcase that climbs to the mezzanine. The kitchen sets the stainless steel of its appliances against orange cabinetry and the stone of its island, beneath a brick ceiling, and a large wine rack of wooden diamonds stands out against a glass panel. Upstairs, the mood settles: exposed wooden beams, large terracotta toned tiles and white walls. The master suite opens onto a private terrace facing the golf course, a second bedroom has its own bathroom and terrace access, and the third, with twin beds, welcomes family or friends. On the ground floor, a TV room, a guest bathroom and a self contained service area, with its own entrance, bedroom, terrace and laundry, complete the home.

Outside, a wooden deck surrounds a pool of deep blue reflections, beneath the palms of the tropical garden. A white pergola shelters the table for long lunches, and a bathroom with a shower lets you move from the water to the garden without going back inside. The greenery frames the view toward the golf course and shields the terrace from view. Anti cyclone curtains, an alarm system, a water softener and two parking spaces complete the property, and the home is sold fully furnished.

Puerto Aventuras, a gated community of the Riviera Maya, brings together a marina, a nine hole golf course, white sand beaches and waterfront restaurants, all within walking distance. The Maya jungle and its cenotes begin close by, while the Caribbean Sea runs along the second largest coral reef in the world. Playa del Carmen is minutes away and Cancún International Airport remains within easy reach. A home of character for living, entertaining or investing on Mexico's Caribbean coast.
